description: NaAlSiO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmc2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.46 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.49 Å. There are two inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-54°. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.03 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-53°. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.07 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to six O atoms to form SiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-53°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-1.87 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to six O atoms to form SiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-54°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-1.85 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Al, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Al, and two equivalent Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Al, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Al₂Si trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Al, and two equivalent Si atoms to form distorted ONa₂AlSi₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂AlSi₂ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₂Al₂Si trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂AlSi₂ square pyramid, and edges with six ONa₂Al₂Si trigonal bipyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Al, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₂Al₂Si trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₂Al₂Si trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₂AlSi₂ square pyramids, and edges with four ONa₂Al₂Si trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Al, and two equivalent Si atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₂AlSi₂ square pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Al, and two equivalent Si atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Al, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₂Al₂Si trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂AlSi₂ square pyramids, corners with nine ONa₂Al₂Si trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₂AlSi₂ square pyramids, and edges with three ONa₂AlSi₂ trigonal bipyramids.
